main_text.p: ᾽Ἐξ ante vocalem, ἐξ αὐλῆς, ex aula: & tamen Theocritus dixit,

--ἀμφοτέρων ἐξ
τοίχων ἀνδρες ἐβαινον,--
--utrisq; ex
Parietibus viri gradiebantur.--
In fine versus, ἐξ praecedit consonam sequentis. Sed poeta est.
Aliquando servit comparationi. Lucian. ἐγὼ ἐξ ἁπάντων ἡ καλλίστη ἔδοξα, ego ex omnibus pulcherrima visa sum: Ex omnibus,pro omnium.

Περὶ πυρῶν, pro foribus, vel ante fo-ρῶν ἐπὶ τῆς πολέμῳ,ante bellum: δοῦλος ἐκ δούλου, servus prae servo: ἐκ τῶν ἰδίων, prae suis & propriis. Herod. πόλεμον πρὸ εἰρήνης αἱρέεται, bellum prae pace optat.
Note: the Greek in the second and third lines is faint and partly damaged; the readings are approximate.

page.notes: Greek text is partly blurred; accents and some letters in the lines beginning "Περὶ" and "ρῶν" are uncertain. Text of the Greek lines above is a best reading.
